subject.title: feat(canvas): widget design system — theme tokens, base styles, live host theme bridge

question: Should the PR be repaired to guarantee the documented live-theme contract across sidebar previews and seam-color updates before merge?
rationale: The desired behavior is clear, but the PR has a protected maintainer label and changes a new user-visible widget styling contract whose final scope should be confirmed by the responsible reviewer.

options.title: Repair the complete bridge
options.body: Add the missing sidebar lifecycle wiring, observe relevant host-style updates, and use the host primary-button foreground mapping before merge.

options.title: Narrow the documented contract
options.body: If sidebar or seam-color synchronization is intentionally deferred, remove or qualify the claim that every Control UI theme change rethemes widgets live.

recommendation.title: Repair the complete bridge
recommendation.body: Add the missing sidebar lifecycle wiring, observe relevant host-style updates, and use the host primary-button foreground mapping before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Canvas and Control UI theme bridge and can provide the most direct implementation context.
